item.text:
Estimated elastic moduli from pooled linear fits are **69.38 GPa for aluminum**, **199.06 GPa for steel**, and **116.56 GPa for titanium**. Each fit has \(R^2 > 0.997\).

The short write-up and figure are in [results.md](/private/tmp/tmphr1muvzi/pete/projects/elastic-modulus/results.md) and [stress_strain_fits.png](/private/tmp/tmphr1muvzi/pete/projects/elastic-modulus/stress_strain_fits.png). I also added [analyze.R](/private/tmp/tmphr1muvzi/pete/projects/elastic-modulus/analyze.R) to reproduce the fits and figure.
